This website does not ask for, collect, or store personal information. It has no
accounts, forms, or comment sections.

The domain is also registered as the home of a private OAuth client in Google
Cloud. I use that client only to connect my own copy of rclone, a file
transfer program, to my own Google Drive so that I can move research data. It
is not offered to anyone else. The files it reads and writes stay in my Google
Drive and on my own computer, and nothing is shared with or sold to any third
party.

Questions about this notice can go to
[billy.thandy21@ui.ac.id](mailto:billy.thandy21@ui.ac.id).
